Figma alternatives

Figma: The design tool, now with Figma Make for turning prompts into working prototypes. If it isn't quite right, here are 14 other AI design and 3D tools from Radar, in Radar's order.

  1. 1CanvaDesign for everyone, with AI to write, generate images and resize everything.Free plan
  2. 2FramerDesign and publish websites, with AI that drafts pages and translates them.Free plan
  3. 3StitchGoogle's app-interface designer: describe a screen, get the design and its code.Free
  4. 4SplineInteractive 3D for the web, with AI for generating objects and textures.Free plan
  5. 5MeshyTextured 3D models from a prompt or a picture, ready for games and 3D printing.Free plan
  6. 6TripoFast image- and text-to-3D, with automatic rigging for animation.Free plan
  7. 7RodinHyper3D's high-detail 3D generation, with clean topology for production.Free plan
  8. 8Blender MCPLets an AI assistant drive Blender: build scenes, model and light by asking.Open source
  9. 9Vectorizer.AITurns pixel images into clean, editable vector graphics.Paid
  10. 10LookaDesigns a logo and brand kit from your business name and taste.Paid
  11. 11Adobe PhotoshopThe photo editor, with Generative Fill and Firefly built in.Paid
  12. 12Adobe ExpressQuick social graphics, flyers and videos with Firefly generation.Free plan
  13. 13Microsoft DesignerGraphics, invitations and social posts from a description.Free
  14. 14UizardApp and web mock-ups from text prompts or hand-drawn sketches.Free plan

Free to start: Canva, Framer, Stitch.
